<a name="liquidity-sdk-viem.liquidityloader.fetch"></a>

## LiquidityLoader.fetch() method

Fetches the shared-liquidity plan for a target market from the Morpho API and onchain state.

**Signature:**

```typescript
fetch(marketId: MarketId): Promise<{
        startState: ReallocationData;
        endState: ReallocationData;
        withdrawals: readonly PublicReallocation[];
        targetBorrowUtilization: bigint;
    }>;
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

marketId


</td><td>

[MarketId](./blue-sdk.md#blue-sdk.marketid)


</td><td>

Target market id to plan withdrawals for.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;{ startState: ReallocationData; endState: ReallocationData; withdrawals: readonly [PublicReallocation](./morpho-sdk.md#morpho-sdk.publicreallocation)<!-- -->\[\]; targetBorrowUtilization: bigint; }&gt;

The start state, simulated end state, computed withdrawals, and target borrow utilization.

## Remarks

The returned `endState` is produced by `ReallocationData.getMarketPublicReallocations` from onchain inputs fetched at one block, with reallocation headroom evaluated one hour after that block timestamp.

## Example


```ts
import type { MarketId } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk";
import { LiquidityLoader } from "@morpho-org/liquidity-sdk-viem";
import { createPublicClient, http } from "viem";
import { mainnet } from "viem/chains";

const client = createPublicClient({
  chain: mainnet,
  transport: http("https://rpc.example"),
});
const loader = new LiquidityLoader(client);

const marketId =
  "0x7bbbb127f5d2886295f50f3cdf86231d9ff45f248639ee1fd3f2bd5d8b129dcf" as MarketId;
const { withdrawals, endState } = await loader.fetch(marketId);

// withdrawals: readonly PublicReallocation[]
// endState: ReallocationData
```

<a name="liquidity-sdk-viem.liquidityparameters.defaultmaxwithdrawalutilization"></a>

## LiquidityParameters.defaultMaxWithdrawalUtilization property

The default maximum utilization allowed to reach to find shared liquidity (scaled by WAD).

**Signature:**

```typescript
defaultMaxWithdrawalUtilization?: bigint;
```

## Default Value

90% (900000000000000000n)

<a name="liquidity-sdk-viem.liquidityparameters.maxwithdrawalutilization"></a>

## LiquidityParameters.maxWithdrawalUtilization property

> Warning: This API is now obsolete.
>
> Per-market source ceilings will be removed in the next major. Use `defaultMaxWithdrawalUtilization` to configure one ceiling for every source. The Morpho API's `targetWithdrawUtilization` is no longer consulted.
>

If provided, defines the maximum utilization allowed to reach for each market, defaulting to `defaultMaxWithdrawalUtilization`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
maxWithdrawalUtilization?: Record<MarketId, bigint>;
```
